title: python/src/lichen/ccp.py: Silent truncation when eui64 is shorter than 8 bytes
description:
The zip(eui64, sfn_bytes) operation silently truncates to the shorter sequence. If eui64 is fewer than 8 bytes, the XOR produces fewer bytes than expected, resulting in incorrect slot assignments without any error.

Fix suggestion: Add validation at function start: `if len(eui64) != 8: raise ValueError('eui64 must be exactly 8 bytes')`
